project_type: Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript + React 19 + Bun application (AI Game Development Platform)
build_system: Bun (must use bun instead of npm/node/pnpm per CLAUDE.md), Next.js build
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun run type-check to validate TypeScript. 2. Run bun run build to validate Next.js build. 3. Run bun run test:run to validate existing tests still pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Bun 1.2.14 available. TypeScript strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. CSP restricts fonts to 'self' data: in next.config.ts - Google Fonts via next/font/google are bundled locally so this is fine.
contribution_requirements: Always use Bun for package management and running scripts (CLAUDE.md). Dark mode is default theme. Use @/ path alias for imports. Use shadcn/ui components.
key_patterns: - Lazy-loaded components with React.lazy() and Suspense/ErrorBoundary wrappers. - shadcn/ui component library in components/ui/. - ThemeProvider from next-themes wraps the app. - Client components marked 'use client'. - cn() utility for className merging. - Existing sidebar-nav uses navItems array with value/label/icon. - All API routes under app/api/. - v2 agent endpoints at /api/agents-v2/.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. components/ - React components (ui/ for shadcn, others for features). lib/ - Utilities, agents, AI, config, auth, DB, validation, monitoring. .github/workflows/ci.yml - CI pipeline.
